source.check: returned unopposed: the only nomination for the division in the list of nominations for Castlederg Rural Council (Belfast News-Letter, 22 April 1927, p. 12, block image read; Derry Journal, 22 April 1927, p. 5); thirteen nominations for sixteen seats

note: Triennial election of the Castlederg rural district councillors, 1927. Thirteen nominations were received for the sixteen divisions (Belfast News-Letter, 22 April 1927, p. 12; Derry Journal, 22 April 1927, p. 5), so no poll was needed; Tyrone's polling day was Wednesday 1 June 1927. Twelve divisions are recorded. Corgary is not recorded: both papers list Mr. William A. Irwin as nominated for Corgary, but both then say no nominations were received for 'Corgary and Clunahill' (the Derry Journal OCR reads 'Cartrary'), so the division of one entry is in doubt. Ballymongan and Longfield are not in the list; Clunahill had no nomination and its retiring councillor, not named, was deemed re-elected. 'All the newly nominated representatives, with one exception, are Unionists.' No labels are printed. Returned unopposed.
